All 19 transitions pass: `python3 check.py` prints **ALL PASS**.

| Action | Effect in `program.py` |
|---|---|
| 3 | Moves the cursor to the editable glyph on the left. From the first glyph, it wraps to the last. |
| 4 | Moves the cursor to the editable glyph on the right. From the last glyph, it wraps to the first. |
| 1, 2, 5, 7, click | No change. |

The data does not confirm one part of the rule. Actions 1 and 2 changed nothing in these transitions. They can possibly change the pixels of a glyph in other states, but I have no observations of this. Also, the move counter did not change in any transition. The file header records this.
